snippet.title: "Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+" Introduction
snippet.description:
The "Hatsune Miku Logic Paint" series is back, powered up with various new features!
More than 1000 new puzzles added! New features "Change Costumes" and "Room Customization" added to the game☆
Enjoy solving puzzles with Miku and friends!

◇An extra large volume of more than double the amount from the previous title!! An addition of more than 1000 new puzzles!
Challenge yourself to 10×10 puzzles, 15×15 puzzles and 20×20 puzzles!
Clear unique stages for each character and collect costumes, room items and special illustrations!
More than 30 new illustrations drawn by popular illustrators!

◇New Features! Customize character costumes and room items as you like ☆ Enjoy solving puzzles with your favorite character!!"
2 new features "Change Costumes" and "Room Customization" are added to this title!
Enjoy the extra cute Miku and friends through both puzzles and room modes!

◇Awarded songs from the piapro Official Collab Song Contest included
30 songs made for "Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+" from the piapro Official Collab Song Contest are included in the game!

"Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+" On Sale from July 24th, 2025
▼For Purchase and Streaming Guidelines (Japanese only)!
https://www.crypton.co.jp/games/Hatsune_Miku_Logic_Paint_Splus
